name: wechaty
description: Talk to LOKI on WeChat (and the other networks Wechaty has a puppet for) like the Telegram channel: LOKI runs a small Wechaty helper (Node) while this is on, you log the bot account in with a QR code, pair your own chat with a one-time code, and only that chat is answered (Ask or Plan mode; group chats ignored; nothing else of the account is used).
license: Apache-2.0 (Wechaty, a separate npm package; LOKI's sidecar engine/wechaty_sidecar.mjs is LOKI's own)
install: python tools/setup_extras.py wechaty   (npm packages into harness_data/addons/wechaty)
notice: The default WeChat puppet uses the web protocol; WeChat may refuse web logins for some (especially new) accounts, and using a personal account with a bot can break WeChat's terms - use a separate account. WeChat-only for now: other puppets (WhatsApp, puppet-service) are chosen with LOKI_WECHATY_PUPPET and installed by hand.
